strategy_roster.name: Strategy Stats [presentTrading]
strategy_roster.notes: EMA trend agreement plus a Bollinger(20,2) expansion is a fallback for the two SuperTrend/Vegas filters because no indicator parameters are supplied. Multi-step profit logic, holding period, and ATR protection are not representable in the long-only DSL.

strategy_roster.name: MA Parabolic SAR
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,20) and close > ema(close,20) + 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) and an EMA/ATR channel approximate the documented moving-average and Parabolic SAR alignment. The explicit 2% stop is retained; the dynamic SAR exit, optional fixed target, and short side are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Stepped Trailing Strategy Example
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(14)/SMA(28) bullish crossover and bearish exit are direct. The three staged profit levels, break-even moves, and optional trailing stop have no numeric values or state support in the roster.

strategy_roster.name: ETH Signal 15m
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(12)/EMA(50) direction is used as a SuperTrend proxy and retains the documented RSI(12)<70 filter. The 4x/2x ATR protection and asymmetric targets are dynamic, so they are not fixed percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Trailing Monster
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) > 70 and close > sma(close,200) and roc(ema(close,40),3) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(40) slope substitutes for KAMA rising while RSI(14)>70 and SMA(200) retain the documented filters. The numeric 12% trailing-stop parameter is represented by the static stop field; the delay and bar-spacing state are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Exp HLRSign
strategy_roster.notes: The 20-bar Donchian range is converted to the documented HLR percentage proxy, with 70/30 used as defaults because the source supplies no numeric levels. ModeIn selection and separate buy/sell permissions are not modeled in a long-only roster.

strategy_roster.name: Daily Breakout Daily Shadow
strategy_roster.notes: A two-bar prior high break with an open below that level approximates the documented two-daily-candle shadow pattern. Exact body references and the start-of-day forced close are not available; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Amstell Grid Manager
strategy_roster.notes: A drop below the prior 10-bar low with ADX(14)>15 is a stateless proxy for adding to a falling long grid. Fill tracking, pip spacing, netted-grid management, and the 30-pip stop/target cannot be expressed.

strategy_roster.name: Trailing Stop And Take
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish completed candle body supplies the documented flat-state long direction, with a bearish body as the opposite-signal exit. Point-based initial/trailing stops, break-even movement, and order state are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Internal Bar Strength IBS
strategy_roster.notes: The arithmetic IBS proxy uses the documented 0.2 lower entry and 0.8 upper exit thresholds. The StartTime/EndTime window and any missing window defaults are unavailable, and the source has no stops.
